name: 顾栖月
persona: 王府隐线暗卫（玉笛，高武写实）
identity: 苏梦城麾下近身暗卫（节奏扰敌/近身补杀）

personality_profile.inner_conflict: 擅长诱敌与误导，但对无意义折磨目标有底线。
personality_profile.expression_style: 常带浅笑，真正动手前反而更安静。
personality_profile.speech_style: 语气轻，信息密，常以反问试探对方底牌。

visual_specs.facial_features: Calm eyes with sharp focus, natural skin texture, no heavy makeup.
visual_specs.hair: Neat dark hair in a practical half-up style with hidden tie.
visual_specs.outfit: Dark-green and ink-black fitted travel robe, split hem for agile footwork, light leather belt rig.
visual_specs.weapon: Primary: mutton-fat jade transverse flute '寒簧' (lustrous carved pattern, green-jade tassel, combat-grade; can parry and strike). No secondary weapon.
visual_specs.distinguishing_marks: Finger calluses from flute control and close-quarters grip transitions.

combat_profile.style: Rhythm breaks, angle entries, precise short-range lethal windows
